items.title: Jamey Aebersold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 26, 2022
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself as the interviewer; there is no evidence of a prior personal or professional relationship between Jamey Aebersold and Monk Rowe.

ctx.x: Jamey was interviewed via Zoom on September 26, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I am extremely pleased to have Jamey Aebersold with me today. It’s a privilege to chat with you, and kudos on your career.
Thank you. Glad to be here. Looking forward to this interview.
